title: Filler: Cloud Watching
later: Clouds'll still be there later. Go do your thing first... what a drag.

offer.speaker: shikamaru
offer.text: Iruka-sensei's lecture is about to start. Which means it's the perfect time to be somewhere else.

offer.speaker: shikamaru
offer.text: Choji and I watch the clouds at the edge of Training Ground 3. Come if you want. Or don't. Too troublesome to argue.

steps.text: Find Shikamaru and Choji at the edge of Training Ground 3
Lie back and watch the clouds

dialogue.speaker: shikamaru
dialogue.text: See that one? Looks like a deer. And that one... like Iruka-sensei when he's yelling.

dialogue.speaker: choji
dialogue.text: *crunch* That one looks like a rice ball. ...I'm hungry.

dialogue.speaker: shikamaru
dialogue.text: Clouds don't have to be anywhere. Sometimes I envy them.

lines.speaker: shikamaru
lines.text: Heh. You get it. Not many do.

choices.text: We'll get in trouble for skipping.
